avatars.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one tiny pixel-art PET avatar for an AgentOS dashboard. Draw exactly ONE animal pet sprite, centered in a square canvas with a genuinely transparent background. TRUE low-resolution pixel art: design it as a 32 by 32 pixel game sprite, then enlarge with nearest-neighbor integer scaling. Clearly visible square pixels, hard stair-step silhouettes, flat limited-color shading, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur, no 3D, no illustration brushwork, no realistic textures, no human characters. Cute compact proportions, huge expressive simple pixel eyes, large head, tiny body and paws, three-quarter front pose. Full pet entirely visible with 8% transparent padding; pet fills 84% of the canvas. Use only a small coordinated palette: terracotta orange #e7663b and #f18a60, ivory #eeeae0, warm charcoal #252723, olive-gray #73796b, muted warm brown #9d633e. Crisp dark outline suitable for ivory AND dark UI backgrounds. No cyan, purple or blue, no text or labels, no watermark, no scenery, no other pets. Each sprite should look from the same polished retro game family.
Subject: Hermes is a tiny orange FOX messenger pet with large pointed ears, an ivory chest and ivory tail tip, a small ivory wing on each shoulder, and a tiny dark olive messenger satchel. Friendly lively pixel eyes. The fox must remain recognizable at 24 pixels.
